title: Ch25h/25HC axis orchestrates phagocytosis and lipid metabolism after intracerebral haemorrhage
title_zh: Ch25h/25HC轴在脑出血后协调吞噬作用和脂质代谢
abstract: Abstract Intracerebral haemorrhage (ICH) is a devastating form of stroke for which therapies are lacking. Secondary brain injury driven by erythrocyte lysis contributes to poor outcomes, highlighting the need to enhance endogenous haematoma clearance. Here, we identify cholesterol 25-hydroxylase (CH25H) and its product 25-hydroxycholesterol (25HC) as key regulators of phagocytic and lipid-handling responses after ICH. CH25H expression was increased in postmortem human ICH tissue and a mouse ICH model, localising predominantly in perihaematomal phagocytes. Lipidomics also revealed that 25HC levels increased in the brain after ICH in mice. Ch25h deficiency in mice exacerbated IgG tissue immunoreactivity, iron deposition, and neurological deficits after ICH. Conversely, 25HC treatment improved functional recovery and reduced tissue pathology. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed selective upregulation of Ch25h in activated microglia after ICH, which modulated phago-lysosomal and lipid metabolic gene expression. Consistently, Ch25h deficiency reduced erythrocyte phagocytosis and increased lipid droplet accumulation in vivo, whereas 25HC promoted phagocytosis and reduced lipid droplets in vitro. Together, these findings identify CH25H/25HC-dependent lipid reprogramming as a critical determinant of phagocyte function and neurological recovery after ICH.
abstract_zh: 摘要 脑出血（ICH）是一种缺乏有效疗法的毁灭性中风形式。由红细胞溶解驱动的继发性脑损伤导致预后不良，凸显了增强内源性血肿清除的必要性。在此，我们确定胆固醇25-羟化酶（CH25H）及其产物25-羟基胆固醇（25HC）作为ICH后吞噬作用和脂质处理反应的关键调节因子。CH25H在术后人类ICH组织和小鼠ICH模型中表达上调，主要定位于血肿周围的吞噬细胞。脂质组学研究还显示，ICH后小鼠大脑中25HC水平升高。小鼠Ch25h缺乏加剧了ICH后的IgG组织免疫反应、铁沉积和神经功能缺损。相反，25HC治疗改善了功能恢复并减少了组织病理变化。单细胞RNA测序揭示了ICH后活化小鼠中Ch25h的选择性上调，该基因调控了吞噬-溶酶体和脂质代谢相关基因表达。一致地，Ch25h缺乏在体内减少了红细胞吞噬作用并增加了脂滴积聚，而25HC则在体外促进了吞噬作用并减少了脂滴积聚。综上，这些研究确定了CH25H/25HC依赖的脂质重编程作为ICH后吞噬细胞功能和神经功能恢复的关键决定因素。
